_comment: The register of divergences the differ FORGIVES, for the fixture product. EMPTY, and it must
stay empty: an accepted difference is a statement that a real product changed behaviour and
somebody signed for it. The fixture product has no behaviour to change and nobody to sign.
It is here because it decides a verdict on identical bytes, which is why harness-rev.sh hashes
it and why replay-selftest.sh loads it against cells.json -- an empty register that LOADS is
the fact those two cases need.
